destructiveStatements.reason: payouts.status is converted from unguarded free text to the payout_status enum so a settled payout cannot be moved back to a claimable state and withdrawn twice. The USING cast is value-preserving (every existing value is a member of the new enum), the DEFAULT is dropped and restored around the change, and the conversion is idempotent behind a pg_attribute type check.

sensitiveStatements.reason: RPC requires elevated privileges to securely mutate dispute states and log audits.

An AFTER INSERT trigger must create the owner's active membership atomically; organization INSERT RLS already requires owner_id = auth.uid() and the venue_owner role, the function uses a fixed search_path, and EXECUTE is revoked from public API roles.

Token-scoped RSVP RPCs expose only minimal invitation fields and bounded response mutation; both use a fixed search_path, direct anon table access stays revoked, and EXECUTE is granted only after revoking PUBLIC.
A trigger validates booking ownership, same-owner dependency links, and dependency cycles with a fixed empty search_path; direct execution is revoked from every API role.
A forward-only repair removes the legacy organization-folder-only policies and restores organization plus venue path validation for authenticated venue-media writes.
A forward-only repair qualifies storage.objects.name so nested venue policy queries validate the uploaded object path instead of public.venues.name.

Booking automation RPCs need atomic cross-table rule evaluation, approval, invoice, decision-audit, and override writes. Every function fixes search_path, checks venue authorization where user-callable, and restricts the final decision RPC to service_role.

Replaces the existing SECURITY DEFINER complete_booking_event() (021) to fix the org+amount payout dedupe collision and emit supplier payouts. Permission checks (is_org_member_for_booking OR is_admin) and the fixed search_path are unchanged from the definition it replaces; no grant is widened.

Only the payout_accounts audit trigger is SECURITY DEFINER, so it can write audit_logs via the internal-only log_audit(). It uses a fixed search_path, is a trigger function reachable only through the table it is attached to, and EXECUTE is revoked from PUBLIC/anon/authenticated in 20260805133000.

The money-out path. request_withdrawal() must bypass the deliberately absent INSERT policy on withdrawal_requests and take FOR UPDATE locks on payouts, so recipients cannot forge or double-claim a payout. Every function re-derives the caller from auth.uid() and re-checks is_org_member/is_supplier_owner/is_admin, uses a fixed search_path, and writes log_audit. Disbursement-lifecycle functions are restricted to service_role and internal helpers to no client role at all in 20260805133000.
